verdict.rationale: Teams docs mention 'Connectors' and 'Outgoing Webhooks' for posting/receiving messages from external web services (ms-teams-docs-12, ms-teams-docs-30), which is the vendor-side basis for an incoming-webhook-style integration, but a developer directly contradicts the 'simple' framing, stating that unlike Slack's simple webhooks, Teams integration 'requires the full Azure/Graph API stack' (ms-teams-comm-11). No dedicated quickstart or docs explicitly walk through generating a bare incoming webhook URL and POSTing a message to it. Missing for 10: an official 'incoming webhook' quickstart/tutorial with a simple curl/POST example, and independent confirmation that setup is as lightweight as competitors claim.
